items.title: Reproduce post-DONE freshness drift without changing completed story semantics
items.context: Use existing B-a57f/B-22b0 observations and a focused smoke fixture to show an already DONE story can be marked evidence-freshness fail after later main material commits even though the story was valid at DONE time.
items.userSees: User sees a reproducible regression note: a DONE story with valid historical test evidence no longer fails freshness just because later main material commits exist.

happy.desc: A focused regression fixture creates a DONE story whose test evidence matches its recorded evidence head, then adds a later unrelated material commit; done_closure reports evidence-freshness pass for that DONE story.

edge.desc: The reproduction does not mutate completed production stories like B-a57f or B-22b0; it uses an isolated temp repo fixture.

adversarial.desc: The regression fails before the fix when DONE story freshness is compared against current HEAD materialHash.

items.title: Make DONE story freshness use the recorded evidence snapshot
items.context: Adjust the DONE oracle freshness row so phase=DONE stories compare test-evidence materialHash to the material tree at evidence.headHash, not current HEAD. Keep active non-DONE gates strict against current workspace HEAD/materialHash.

items.title: Add regression coverage for post-DONE main movement
items.context: Add/extend smoke coverage proving done_closure for a DONE story stays non-blocking after later unrelated material commits, while active TEST evidence still goes stale when material files change.
